sources.title: Introducing NER-UK 2.0: A Rich Corpus of Named Entities for Ukrainian
sources.snippet: This paper presents NER-UK 2.0, a corpus of texts in the Ukrainian language manually annotated for the named entity recognition task. The corpus contains 560 texts of multiple genres, boasting 21,993 entities in total.
